## Problem 1
Let's read the penguins dataset:
```{r load pegunis}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The penguins dataset contains measurements and characteristics of penguins.

It has `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.

The variables are `r paste(names(penguins), collapse = ", ")`.

The species are `r paste(unique(penguins$species), collapse = ", ")`,

The islands are `r paste(unique(penguins$island), collapse = ", ")`.

Bill length and flipper length are measured in millimeters.

The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` mm.

### scatterplot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r peguin_plot}
scatter_plot = ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    x = bill_length_mm, 
    y = flipper_length_mm, 
    color = species
      )
) + 
  geom_point()

scatter_plot
```
